q: Tests influence LLM software engineering through specification, generation, refinement, selection, behavioral comparison, analysis, and agent control.
r: IC1: a scoping survey of test-driven methods across general LLM software engineering tasks (clone detection, code search, translation); agent skills are one section, not SDD, context files or coding-agent evaluation.

q: we present DevAI, a new benchmark of 55 realistic automated AI development tasks.
r: Include: new benchmark plus Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation method, comparing MetaGPT, GPT-Pilot and OpenHands on project-level development tasks; the contribution is the evaluation method.
